$comment: LDAP / Active Directory source template — INBOUND federation source.
Registers a corporate LDAP/AD directory so users can sign in with their
directory credentials and be JIT-provisioned + linked by verified email.
Feed to ZITADEL Management API: POST /management/v1/idps/ldap with an
Authorization: Bearer <mgmt PAT from KV> header.
The bind password is NEVER stored here. {{ldap_bind_password}} is resolved
from the KV config store at apply time by the tooling.
name: Corporate Directory (LDAP/AD)
$attributes_notes: Map directory attributes to ZITADEL user fields. userPrincipalName and
mail are the identifiers that feed verified-email auto-linking.
